item.title: Norway 1-2 England: World Cup quarter-final player ratings from Miami
item.description:
England’s Resilience on Display as They Edge Past Norway in Thrilling Quarter-Final Encounter

In a sweltering Miami night, England’s squad demonstrated their trademark grit and determination as they outlasted Norway 2-1 in a pulsating World Cup quarter-final encounter. The Three Lions’ victory marked a major milestone in their campaign, as they edged closer to realizing their dream of lifting the coveted trophy.

At the heart of England’s triumph was a resolute defensive display, spearheaded by the imperious Marc Guéhi, who engaged in an epic battle with his Manchester City teammate Erling Haaland. Guéhi’s tireless efforts were instrumental in limiting Norway’s attacking threat, as he marshaled the backline with a series of crucial interventions, including an eye-catching block to deny Antonio Nusa’s late shot.
